messages:
Oliver T: Hey y'all, new hire here (Oliver). My calendar is showing two separate "Welcome + Orientation" invites both at 11:00 but one is flagged as 11:00 PST and the other as 11:00 local. The PST one has the Zoom link, the local one just says 'Add conferencing'. Which one do I join? I'm in Bogotá (UTC-5).

Camila R: Welcome Oliver! :wave: Join the one with the Zoom link (that's the canonical global session). The duplicate usually comes from mismatched timezone metadata in the ICS.

PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: Global New Hire Orientation at 11:00 AM ET. Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.com/orientation/mar2026 Passcode: 9988. Recording will be uploaded to Confluence: /onboarding/recordings. If your invite lacks conferencing, check the PeopleOps calendar or ping here.

Oliver T: Thanks. Outlook shows both and they overlap. On mobile the times look different too.

IT Support: Hi Oliver 12 this happens when one invite was created with organizer timezone America/New_York and another with organizer timezone UTC. Some clients (Outlook/Apple Calendar) render both. Quick fixes: 1) delete both events and re-add from the invite that contains the Zoom link; or 2) edit one event -> set explicit timezone dropdown to 'Eastern Time (US & Canada)' to match the other then save. We'll also resend normalized invites.

Zoe: For Apple Calendar users: open the duplicate event -> Edit -> Time Zone -> toggle "Time Zone Support" on and set to Eastern Time, save. That collapses duplicates for me.

Camila R: IT, please resend with conferenceData and an explicit recording placeholder in the description ("Recording: https://confluence.redwood.com/onboarding/records/mar2026"). Also add the passcode in the description so older clients can join.

IT Support: Will do 1 resending now to new-hires-mar2026 list with timezone=America/New_York for the main event and conferenceData/joinUrl included. If you still see two items after ~5m, please remove both and add from the new invite. DM screenshots if it persists.

Oliver T: New invite came through. Deleted old ones, re-added the new one. Link and passcode visible, time shows correctly as 11:00 for me. Thanks!

Camila R: Awesome, welcome again. Recording will be posted within an hour after the session. If you need a catch-up, book a "New Hire Catch-up" slot on the PeopleOps calendar.
